# GitHub Copilot Instructions for BTrace

Follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md), the canonical guide for coding agents in this repository: module
map, non-negotiable rules, build and verification commands, and documentation placement.

This file intentionally repeats none of it, so it cannot drift from AGENTS.md. Contributor setup
(JDK toolchains, running tests) is in [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md); procedures for specific
tasks are skills under [`.agents/skills/`](../.agents/skills/).
